t: You're on George Street in Marylebone, which runs east from Edgware Road to Marylebone High Street, at the junction with Thayer Street. On the way it crosses Seymour Place, Gloucester Place, Manchester Street and Baker Street. The street takes its name from George III, who reigned from 1760 to 1820 and was the first Hanoverian monarch born in Great Britain. The painter Joseph Murray Ince died on this street. He was known for landscapes, drawings and watercolours of Welsh scenes and of Cambridge and Oxford colleges.
